name: Piso
bio: Piso is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 424.

poems.title: Book XI, 424
poems.author: Piso
poems.text: Don’t expect flowers from the land of Galatia, from whose bosom sprang the Furies, destroyers of men.
